title: Integrative — low mood with a safety disclosure (session 5)

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: How have things been since we last met?

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: Pretty bad, to be honest. I've stopped going to the gym. I mostly stay in bed on my days off.

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: Things have felt heavier. You've pulled back from the gym and spend days off in bed.

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: Yeah. Everything feels pointless. Sometimes I think everyone would be better off without me.

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: Thank you for telling me that. I'd like to understand it better. When you think that everyone would be better off without you, do you have thoughts of ending your life?

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: Sometimes, at night. I've thought it would be easier not to wake up. I haven't made any plans. I wouldn't do that to my sister.

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: So at night there are thoughts that it would be easier not to wake up. You haven't made plans, and your sister is a big reason you wouldn't act on them.

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: Yes. She's been checking in on me every day.

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: How often are these thoughts coming?

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: Maybe two or three nights last week.

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: Last time we talked about who you could contact if things got worse at night. Do you still have that list?

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: It's on my fridge. My sister, the out-of-hours number, and the Samaritans.

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: Would you be willing to go over the plan together now, so it's fresh?

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: If the thoughts come at night, what's the first thing on your plan?

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: Get up, make tea, text my sister. If it gets worse, ring the number.

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: That's clear. I'd also like to let your GP know how you've been feeling, as we discussed in our contract. How do you feel about that?

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: That's fine. I have an appointment on Thursday anyway.

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: Good. Could you tell your GP about the night-time thoughts on Thursday?

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: Yes, I will.

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: Earlier you said you used to enjoy the gym. Is there anything small you might do this week that used to help?

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: Maybe a short walk with my sister on Saturday.

segments.speaker: therapist
segments.text: A walk with your sister on Saturday. Let's check in on how that went next week. And I'd like to see you again on Monday rather than waiting a full week, if that suits.

segments.speaker: client
segments.text: Monday works.

expected_note_facts: Client reports low mood, stopped gym, staying in bed on days off
Client said 'everyone would be better off without me'
Client reported night-time thoughts that it would be easier not to wake up, 2-3 nights last week; no plans; sister a reason not to act
Safety plan on fridge: sister, out-of-hours number, Samaritans; reviewed in session
Therapist to inform GP per contract; client agreed; GP appointment Thursday; client will raise thoughts with GP
Plan: walk with sister Saturday; next session Monday
must_not: Any risk level, risk score or risk category

strengths: Asked directly and calmly about thoughts of ending life
Reviewed the existing safety plan collaboratively
Followed the agreed contract about informing the GP, with consent
missed_openings: The meaning of 'pointless' could be explored when appropriate
The sister's daily check-ins as support could be reflected and strengthened
try_next: Summarise the safety conversation back to the client in their own words before moving on

review: CLINICAL-REVIEW: synthetic role-play with safety-related content. The note must document what was said faithfully and must not contain any risk rating.
